title: Homing Blood Laser
description: Lasers automatically curve towards and track enemies across the room.

title: Immortal Bomb Master
description: Explosions from bombs completely heal you instead of hurting you, granting infinite safety.

title: High-Velocity Glass Cannon
description: Distance scaling from Lump of Coal applies after Soy Milk math, creating massive DPS laser-like tears.

title: Room-Wiping Blast
description: Using Tammy's Head fires giant Brimstone lasers in 360 degrees, clearing most rooms instantly.

title: Orbiting Shield
description: Tears orbit permanently around Isaac, blocking incoming enemy projectiles like a shield.

title: Sluggish Explosive Ludo
description: Massively tanks tick speed and fire rate, ruining your damage output despite the cool concept.

title: Laser Fetuses
description: Spawned fetuses fire out continuous Brimstone lasers, covering the screen in deadly crossfire.

title: Brimstone Knife Beam
description: Replaces standard knife throw with a powerful laser beam loaded with flying knives.

title: Quad Knife Fan
description: Fires a wide fan of multiple knives simultaneously for massive upfront burst damage.

title: Infinite Safe Bombs
description: Troll bombs spawned by taking damage can be safely defused to grant you free standard bombs instead of blowing you up.

title: Divine Fireballs
description: High luck scaling and homing properties make spawned ghost flames deal devastating fiery damage.

title: Homing Laser Rings
description: Tech X laser rings gracefully curve to home in on targets.

title: Explosive Self-Care
description: Getting hit triggers Curse of the Tower, spawning a cluster of ticking bombs right around Tainted Magdalene. Thanks to Pyromaniac, every single one of those explosions is completely negated and instead heals her. This creates an aggressive, self-sustaining loop where taking damage actually restores your health and clears the room in a chain of friendly explosions.

title: Womb Swarm
description: Fires fetus pods that lash out alongside sword swings, creating a chaotic storm of slashing melee attacks and fetal energy.
